EURUSD.state: Selling pressure holds the near-term path lower below 1.1455, but heavy chop and unstable transition leave the broader structure completely unresolved.
paragraphs: Sellers maintain near-term control with an immediate six-brick bearish run pushing price down to 1.139. That move has broken the latest confirmed low at 1.1455, establishing a downward swing structure of lower highs and lower lows. The path of least resistance tilts lower, reflecting persistent downside attempts rather than any immediate buyer defense.

The broader 104-brick history remains balanced between 53 bullish and 51 bearish bricks, but recent behavior shows a stark shift. Over the past twelve runs, bearish sequences have lengthened significantly to an average of 3.5 bricks while bullish counters stall out at an average of 1.33 bricks. Continuation ticked down slightly to 33.7 while re-acceleration climbed to 17.3, pointing to sharper individual down legs without a clean trend taking root.

The first reclaim cluster sits just overhead, anchored by the broken 1.1455 swing low, the Bollinger middle band at 1.14295, and the neutral SAR sitting at 1.14808. Reclaiming that zone would signal an immediate stall in downside pressure, whereas the falling trend anchor far above at 1.16086 defines the higher-order structural ceiling.

Volatility envelope width remains expanded but is actively contracting, and low opposing wick pressure of 5.5 indicates that buyers are offering minimal rejection to current selling. At the same time, a developing bullish Bat harmonic pattern is present near 1.139, suggesting that while the immediate move encounters little friction, it interacts directly with a potential reversal geometry.

Unstable transition and high chop dominate the structural readout, meaning that this bearish shift has not yet removed the underlying disorder of the market. Proving that the downside move is becoming durable requires consistent directional timing and sustained run expansion, whereas a failure to hold current levels will keep the broader structure trapped in erratic chop.
